title: The Cipher of Tashkent
author: Casper Joubert
blurb: Cyrus Ashgrove, a financial-crimes investigator drowning in clean money, keeps a go-bag packed and a lie polished. Then a burner phone that shouldn't exist starts ringing with a familiar voice on the line — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must extract a defector who may be the bait before the extraction flight leaves at dawn.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
